body.purpose: Input values, option lists, and general readouts.

label.purpose: Technical metadata, stats, and column headers.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button used for submitting guesses.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #7af0c8; color: #05131d; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 12px; border: 0; padding: 14px 14px; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; height: 56px; transition: background-color 0.18s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: #5bd3ab; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background-color: #1b212a; color: #8b95a3; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input Flat
components.description: Text input used for typing model guesses.
components.css: .ds-input-flat { width: 100%; height: 44px; background-color: #1b212a; color: #eef2f6; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; outline: 0; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-input-flat::placeholder { color: #8b95a3; } .ds-input-flat:focus { border-color: #7af0c8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(122, 240, 200, 0.22); }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: Standard container card for stats, instructions, or layout boxes.
components.html:
Coche del Día

Adivina el coche del día en 5 intentos.
components.css: .ds-card-container { background-color: #14181e; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); border-radius: 18px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-card-title { color: #eef2f6; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; } .ds-card-body { color: #8b95a3; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; margin: 0; }

components.name: Attempt Chip
components.description: Display chip for past guess validation attributes (brand, model, year).
components.css: .ds-attempt-chip { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 10px; min-height: 40px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); background-color: #1b212a; color: #eef2f6; } .ds-chip-text { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; width: 100%; } .ds-chip-sub { font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 400; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tone-good { background-color: rgba(122, 240, 200, 0.14); border-color: rgba(122, 240, 200, 0.38); } .ds-tone-good .ds-chip-sub { color: #7af0c8; }

narrative.overview: Structured, clean, and engineered. Coche del Día feels like premium automotive equipment rather than a casual web toy. The interface emphasizes high information density, crisp dividers, and tactile micro-interactions.
keyCharacteristics: High Information Density: UI elements are compact, letting the central car image dominate the viewport.
Engineered Layouts: Borders are fine, spacing is precise, and inputs feel like physical cockpit buttons.
Immediate Engagement: Zero splash screens or blocking animations; instant feedback on every keypress.

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary accent (Menta Neon) is used strictly on active controls and successful feedback. It must never occupy more than 10% of any screen.

rules.name: The Fallback Fail Rule
rules.body: Bad states (failed guesses) must use a sober, non-fluorescent red (#e26060) to prevent the screen from looking overly chaotic or cheap.

rules.name: The Technical Label Rule
rules.body: Every input label and metadata field must use Space Mono in uppercase with wide tracking to reinforce the instrument panel aesthetic.

rules.name: The Flat-Border Rule
rules.body: Containers use a fine 1px border with a low-opacity white (rgba(255,255,255,0.06)) to define surfaces instead of drop shadows.

rules.name: The Active State Rule
rules.body: Depth is created dynamically through interactive feedback: active buttons scale down (98%) and focused inputs receive a solid Menta Neon outline.

dos: Do use uppercase Space Mono with at least 0.26em letter-spacing for all form labels.
Do ensure active buttons scale down to 98% on press to simulate a mechanical button.
Do keep borders at exactly 1px thickness with low opacity (rgba(255,255,255,0.06)) to define containers.
donts: Don't use neon purple or blue gradients anywhere in the UI.
Don't use side-stripe borders (e.g., border-left-4) on cards or list items.
Don't use glassmorphism or blur filters as default background decorations.
Don't let text overflow grids; headlines must clamp correctly on mobile layouts.
